item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 20/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong this morning. There will be a few showers over the region. The replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China towards the weekend. A broad area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the Luzon Strait early next week.

Date/Month: 20/09 (Tuesday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms at first. Sunny intervals during the day.
